enter_the_amount_of_cash_you_have: Enter the amount of cash you have including money in your bank account(s), whatever the source (e.g. salary, rental income, benefits etc.)
if_you_have_lent_money_to_someone_and_ar: If you have lent money to someone and are confident it will be repaid, or you've sold something and are due to receive payment, you need to pay Zakat on these amounts.
if_you_are_not_sure_how_much_your_gold_a: If you're not sure how much your gold and silver is worth you can enter the weight in grams. One tola is equal to 11.7 grams.
if_you_own_stocks_and_shares_zakat_is_du: If you own stocks and shares, Zakat is due on them. Enter the current market value of these investments below.
if_you_have_a_defined_contribution_pensi: If you have a defined contribution pension scheme, Zakat is due on specific assets in the fund. If you don't know which assets are in the fund, select the type of pension and the calculator will work out the amount on which Zakat is payable.
my_ISAs_junior_ISAs_and_child_trust_fund: My ISAs, Junior ISAs & Child Trust Funds
zakat_is_payable_on_ISAs_and_Child_Trust: Zakat is payable on ISAs and Child Trust Funds. It's important that you enter the full value of your investment and the calculator will do the rest.
enter_the_value_of_any_cryptocurrencies_: Enter the value of any cryptocurrencies you own in pounds.
business_assets_include_cash: Business assets include cash, receivables (money owed to the business) and stock. Stock should be valued at the retail price. If you have bought property with the sole intention to resell, then include an estimate of the current value of your equity in the property.
for_long_term_debts: For long-term debts (e.g. mortgage), payments and bills, only enter amounts that are either due now or overdue. For businesses, any tax liabilities in relation to a prior financial year that are still to be paid can also be deducted.

background_location_description: SalaTime uses your location to refresh prayer times, adhan reminders and the widget after you move about 3 km. Background access allows these updates while you use another app or lock the screen. You choose access in the system dialog. With While Using access, updates take place while SalaTime is open. Your location may be sent to prayer calculation and city lookup services.
background_location_dialog_message: Open the settings, select Location, then choose "Allow all the time" so prayer times can update automatically.

onboarding_welcome_body: This assistant will help you configure the application.
onboarding_settings_body: You can change these settings for each prayer at any time in the application settings.
onboarding_enable_adhan_description: Play the Adhan for enabled prayers
onboarding_battery_note: To keep the Adhan and reminders reliable, Android may ask you to allow SalaTime to run without battery optimization when you finish.
battery_optimization_granted: SalaTime can now run reliably in the background.
battery_optimization_not_granted: Battery optimization is still active. You can try again at any time.
alarm_window_description: Alarms are refreshed when you open SalaTime. Skip a prayer to silence only that occurrence and its reminders. Pull down to refresh.
alarm_rolling_window_description: Alerts for the next @days days are renewed automatically. The list includes days held in reserve: open SalaTime regularly to extend the available times. Skipping a prayer silences only that occurrence and its reminders.
alarm_refresh_failed: Some alarms could not be updated. Check permissions, then refresh.
alarm_precision_description: Android may delay these reminders. Allow exact alarms for more reliable timing.
no_upcoming_alarms: No upcoming alarms. Enable prayer notifications, then refresh.
skip_this_prayer: Skip this prayer and its reminders
qibla_map_pick_location: Tap your position on the map. The line points toward the Kaaba; no compass permission is needed.
qibla_map_north_up: North stays at the top. Align the line with nearby streets or buildings. The map needs an internet connection.
widget_open_to_refresh: Open SalaTime to refresh prayer times
missed_prayer_body: A prayer alarm passed while your phone was off. Open SalaTime to view the times.
prayer_times_calculated_locally: Prayer times calculated on this device using your selected method.
alarm_test_body: This is a test of your selected prayer sound.
alarm_volume_note: The Adhan respects the phone’s silent and vibrate modes. Otherwise, it uses the alarm volume. Android may show an alarm clock icon for the next prayer.
alarm_last_delay: The last alarm arrived @minutes minutes late.
alarm_audio_failed: The last Adhan could not play normally. Check the alarm volume and notification sound, then test again.
alarm_samsung_sleep: On Samsung, remove SalaTime from Sleeping and Deep sleeping apps, or add it to Never sleeping apps in the battery settings.
alarm_test_instructions: Start a test, lock your phone, and wait one minute without opening SalaTime.
alarm_test_scheduled: Test scheduled. Lock your phone and wait one minute.
widget_resize_hint: Resize the widget on your home screen to show the full prayer schedule.
widget_add_manual: Add SalaTime from your launcher’s widget menu.
widget_prompt_body: Add the SalaTime widget to your home screen. You can also add it later in Settings.

widget_ios_hint: On iPhone, choose the widget size in the Home Screen widget gallery.
widget_ios_steps:
1. Touch and hold an empty area of your Home Screen.
2. Tap Edit, then Add Widget (or +).
3. Search for SalaTime.
4. Swipe to the size you want, then tap Add Widget.
ramadan_isha_description: Applies only to Ramadan nights, starting on the evening before the first day, according to SalaTime’s Hijri calendar and its correction. Your personal Maghrib and Isha adjustments still apply.
